sentences.text: Well, the thing is, I'd like a nice quiet afternoon.

sentences.title: Offering and asking for help
sentences.text: Oh, don't worry, Mum. After lunch, we plan to study upstairs in my room.

sentences.title: Offering and asking for help
sentences.text: Oh! It's ready!

sentences.title: Offering and asking for help
sentences.text: Be careful, Joe. It's very hot. Can I help you?

sentences.title: Offering and asking for help
sentences.text: It's okay, Mum. I can just... Oh, no! My lasagna! It's all over the floor!

sentences.title: Offering and asking for help
sentences.text: Now what?

sentences.title: Offering and asking for help
sentences.text: Well, first, let's clean it all up. And then, do you and your friends want to go to the new sandwich shop?

sentences.title: Offering and asking for help
sentences.text: Not really. But I've got an idea, Mum. We can just have the salad.

sentences.title: Offering and asking for help
sentences.text: Okay. And you and I can make some chocolate-covered bananas so your friends can have some dessert, too.

sentences.title: Offering and asking for help
sentences.text: Thanks, Mum. You're the best!
